377:t_3:8.en:
$$桂$$
「I see. So that's why they see $$鉄人$$, which uses solar energy, as an enemy.」

377:t_3:9.en:
$$正太郎$$
「We did manage to defeat $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$ once with $$鉄人$$'s solar power during the $$時獄戦役$$.」

377:t_3:13.en:
$$ティティ$$
「I'm sorry, $$正太郎$$. It's my fault $$鉄人$$'s controller was stolen...」

377:t_3:14.en:
$$正太郎$$
「I was at fault too, for not explaining properly. Please don't worry about it.」

377:t_3:16.en:
$$勝平$$
「You're okay with that!? We and $$鉄人$$ could've been blown to bits if things had gone wrong!」

377:t_3:17.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Everyone makes mistakes and messes up.」

377:t_3:18.en:
$$正太郎$$
「What matters is learning something from it. Just like $$グーラ$$ did.」

377:t_3:19.en:
$$ティティ$$
「That boy... Is he your friend, $$正太郎$$?」

377:t_3:20.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Yes. We were born on different planets, but he's a dear friend of mine.」

377:t_3:21.en:
$$ロゼ$$
「$$正太郎$$'s smile... Maybe that really is the sun come down to Earth.」

377:t_3:23.en:
$$ケンジ$$
「You look cheerful, even though $$ズール$$ turned out to be alive.」

377:t_3:24.en:
$$タケル$$
「If he's come back to life, I'll just defeat him again.」

377:t_3:25.en:
$$タケル$$
「I don't see it as a pointless battle. I believe it's my mission.」

377:t_3:27.en:
$$タケル$$
(The words 'the True War' that $$ゲシュタルト$$ mentioned... I heard them during the $$時獄戦役$$ too...)

377:t_3:28.en:
$$タケル$$
(Those words give me a strange sense of dread. What on earth is it...?)

377:t_3:29.en:
$$タケル$$
(Could that be the source of the uneasiness I've been feeling...?)

377:t_3:34.en:
$$ギルター$$
「That man called $$ゲシュタルト$$! He talked so big, and in the end, he failed!」

377:t_3:35.en:
$$ギルター$$
「...Well, no matter. He failed, so it doesn't count as my mistake. Now I just have to strike them while they're worn out...」

377:t_3:36.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「...You've made quite a mess, $$ギルター$$.」

377:t_3:37.en:
$$ギルター$$
「$$サルディアス$$! I-I haven't done anything yet!」

377:t_3:38.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「But you let an outsider into $$ターミナル・ベース$$, didn't you?」

377:t_3:40.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「You see, our boss seems ve-e-ery upset about that.」

377:t_3:41.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Apparently, that outsider... broke into our network and stole $$サイデリアル$$'s classified information.」

377:t_3:43.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「By the way, $$ギルター$$... Do you know who that outsider really is?」

377:t_3:44.en:
$$ギルター$$
「H-he had the traits of someone from the $$ギシン星$$ system...」

377:t_3:45.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Sigh... If you pride yourself on your intellect, I'd like you to know a little more about things.」

377:t_3:47.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「...No, there's no point in you knowing.」

377:t_3:48.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Of course, the boss sees helping that man as absolutely unforgivable... A betrayal of trust, you might say.」

377:t_3:49.en:
$$ギルター$$
「W-what should I do!? Tell me, $$サルディアス$$...!」

377:t_3:50.en:
$$ギルター$$
「No! Please tell me, Lord $$サルディアス$$!」

377:t_3:51.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Hmm... With your past blunders too, I think the combined weight seals your fate. I can't see any way to turn it around...」

377:t_3:52.en:
$$ギルター$$
「P-please, find a way...! I don't want to be demoted to $$アンタレス$$!」

377:t_3:53.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「...Would you do anything?」

377:t_3:55.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「If you're that determined, I'll lend you something special. Used properly, it should unleash tremendous power.」

377:t_3:56.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「If you use it to bury $c, the boss might forgive you.」

377:t_3:57.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Thank you! Thank you, Lord $$サルディアス$$!」

377:t_3:58.en:
$$サルディアス$$
(Now, $$ギルター$$... Can you master it?)

377:t_10:3.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well done, $$正太郎$$. I, $$ＡＧ$$, am overwhelmed with gratitude for the wonderful thing you've shown me.」

377:t_10:4.en:
$$正太郎$$
「What wonderful thing did I show you?」

377:t_10:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Your friendship with Prince $$グーラ$$. When you two worked together to defeat an enemy, I produced $$Ｚチップ$$s myself.」

377:t_10:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「50 Z, to be exact... I'll add them to the squad's stock.」

377:t_10:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I'm surprised myself. It must be because I've watched you and Prince $$グーラ$$ ever since the $$時獄戦役$$.」

377:t_10:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「And so, I will continue to cheer you both on.」

377:t_10:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(That pure heart... It will become the power that breaks through the darkness.)

377:t_10:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(If dark powers gather, so will powers of light... The two diverging paths to $$シンカ$$ can only meet in battle, I suppose...)

377:t_10:19.en:
$$宗介$$
「You fought well on your own until $$正太郎$$ returned. You're a full-fledged warrior now.」

377:t_10:22.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It's delighted. Having everyone recognize it must make it happy.」

377:t_10:24.en:
$$シモン$$
「What did it say this time?」

377:t_10:25.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It says that one day, it wants to give $$正太郎$$ advice, just as $$チェインバー#pilot$$ does.」

377:t_10:26.en:
$$宗介$$
「That's fine, but don't insert stupid jokes in the middle of combat like a certain someone.」

377:t_10:28.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「'I reject your statement. $$アル$$ was the finest instructor I could have had...'」

377:t_10:29.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「'You refuse to acknowledge that, you lowest, foulest shit maggot on Earth, you towering heap of excrement...' That's what it says.」

377:t_10:32.en:
$$カレン$$
「I can't imagine $$オックス$$, $$正太郎$$'s little brother, saying something that vulgar.」

377:t_10:34.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「W-well then, $$オックス$$! To celebrate your performance today, give us a shout!」

377:t_10:35.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Here we go! Let's give it our all today...」
